title: Pupils of St. John the Divine, The By the author of “The Heir of Redclyffe.”
author: Charlotte Mary Yonge
date: '1868'
genre: 'Non-fiction: history'
publication-format: Book
publisher: 'London and New York: Macmillan and Company.'
serialization: Macmillan\'s Sunday Library
illustrator: Edward Armitage
---

Macmillan’s Sunday Library (originally the Sunday Library for Household Reading) was published in monthly parts at 1s. each (of which the Pupils formed the first 3 parts) and quarterly volumes at 4s. each (of which it formed volume I).
